title: Proprietary Food

official_sources.title: Food Products Standards & Food Additives Compendium — current chapter index
How to apply for licence for Proprietary Food

regulatory_notes: Chapter 2.12 is a regulatory route, not a catalogue of standardized product identities.
The current consolidated Chapter 2.12 contains clauses (1) through (6) under 2.12.1.

A proposal visible on the FSSAI comments/ePC platform would insert clauses (1a) and (1b) on when modified standardized foods remain standardized or move to proprietary licensing. Those proposed clauses are not present in the current consolidated Chapter 2.12 and are therefore not treated as operative in PMSV.
A mere deviation in the quality parameters of an otherwise standardized food does not make the resultant product a proprietary food.

classification_router.purpose: Determine whether a formulation may use the Proprietary Food route under the current operative Chapter 2.12 framework.

decision_steps.question: Is the food standardized under the FSSAI Food Products Standards and Food Additives Regulations?
decision_steps.yes_action: Apply the applicable standardized product standard. Do not classify as proprietary merely because a quality parameter deviates.

decision_steps.question: Does the product fall into an excluded class?
excluded_classes: Any other food article notified by the Central Government as excluded
decision_steps.yes_action: Do not use Chapter 2.12 Proprietary Food route; use the applicable separate regulation/approval route.

decision_steps.question: Are all non-additive ingredients eligible under clause 2.12.1(2)?
acceptable_basis: Ingredient is standardized under applicable Food Safety and Standards Regulations
Ingredient is otherwise permitted for use in preparation of food products under Food Safety and Standards Regulations
Food/ingredient is mentioned in Indian Food Composition Tables (IFCT), 2017, National Institute of Nutrition
exclusions: Ingredient specifically restricted/specifed otherwise by FSSAI from time to time
Ingredient sourced from species prohibited under the Wildlife Protection Act hunting restrictions
decision_steps.vitamins_minerals_rule: Vitamins and minerals may be present up to one Recommended Dietary Allowance of the respective micronutrient under the Chapter 2.12 clause.
decision_steps.fail_action: Do not conclude proprietary-food compliance; regulatory clearance/alternate route must be established.

decision_steps.question: Which Food Category System category/sub-category best describes the proprietary food?
decision_steps.action: Assign the nearest applicable FCS category/sub-category for additive and microbiological rule inheritance.
decision_steps.label_requirement: The applicable category/sub-category shall be mentioned on the label along with the generic name, nature and composition of the proprietary food.

decision_steps.rule: Use only additives, and only at levels, allowed in Appendix A for the selected category/sub-category.
decision_steps.hard_fail_if: An additive is not permitted for the selected FCS or exceeds its applicable maximum level.

decision_steps.rule: Apply Appendix B microbiological requirements for the selected food category.
decision_steps.fallback_rule: If Appendix B has no specified microbiological standard for the selected food/category, the product shall not contain pathogenic microorganisms at a level that may render it unsafe.

decision_steps.rule: Comply with all other applicable regulations under the Food Safety and Standards Act.
decision_steps.claims_rule: Health claims require adequate and scientific substantiation. Current Advertising and Claims and Labelling/Display requirements must also be checked before PMSV issues a claims conclusion.

decision_steps.rule: The Food Business Operator is fully responsible for the safety of the proprietary food for human consumption.

operative_rules.rule: Proprietary food is a food not standardized under these regulations, excluding the listed separately regulated classes.
operative_rules.safeguard: Deviation in quality parameters of a standardized food does not by itself qualify that food as proprietary.

operative_rules.rule: Use only standardized/permitted ingredients or foods/ingredients in IFCT 2017, subject to FSSAI restrictions and Wildlife Protection Act exclusions; vitamins/minerals may be added up to one RDA.
Only additives and levels permitted in Appendix A for the applicable category/sub-category may be used; category/sub-category must be declared with generic name, nature and composition.
Comply with Appendix B; where no microbiological standard exists, pathogenic microorganisms must not be present at a level rendering the food unsafe.
Comply with all other applicable regulations. Health claims require adequate and scientific evidence.
FBO bears full responsibility for safety for human consumption.

proposals_not_active.summary: Proposed framework distinguishing standardized products with ingredient/additive changes that do or do not alter defined horizontal/vertical parameters.
proposals_not_active.implementation_rule: Track for future update, but do not use for operative pass/fail or licensing classification until incorporated into the current notified/consolidated regulation.

required_databases: PMSV permitted ingredient database / IFCT eligibility references
Appendix A additive database by FCS
Appendix B microbiology database by FCS
Current contaminants, processing aids, labelling and claims layers
runtime_policy.final_compliance_lock: Do not issue a final proprietary-food compliant conclusion until the standardized-product gate, excluded-class gate, ingredient eligibility, nearest FCS, Appendix A, Appendix B and all other applicable FSSAI regulatory layers are machine-validated.

foscos_route_implementation.standardized_product_gate: Search the current FoSCoS/FSSAI standardized-product catalogue first. If a matching standard applies, use the standardized route rather than Chapter 2.12.
foscos_route_implementation.proprietary_entry: Where no standardized product applies and the food is not in an excluded separately regulated class, assess Chapter 2.12 eligibility.
application_fields: Nearest Food Category System category and sub-category
Ingredient statement with FSSR standard/permission basis
Additive statement with INS number and applicable maximum/GMP level
foscos_route_implementation.category_rule: Do not hard-code Food Category 15 or 16 as always proprietary. The current standardized-product catalogue is checked first because standardized mappings can change over time.
foscos_route_implementation.final_gate: A Chapter 2.12 candidate is not a compliance pass. Ingredient eligibility, Appendix A, Appendix B and every other applicable FSSAI regulation must still be validated.
